name: Feedback

trigger.notes: Marketing window 08:00-21:00 contact TZ. Uses {{contact.current_review_link}} as an opaque string. No Google Maps.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Added by WF-06 at T+14
named_steps.comment: Sole enroll path. No other trigger.

named_steps.name: SMS: Feedback invite (inline, first in this sequence)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. First SMS in this sequence carries Reply STOP to opt out. Uses {{contact.current_review_link}} as a string. Marketing window 08:00-21:00 contact TZ.

named_steps.name: EMAIL: Feedback invite (native template)
named_steps.comment: Sends EML | WF-10 | Feedback invite. References {{contact.current_review_link}}.

named_steps.name: WAIT: +3 days (marketing window)
named_steps.comment: Space before the nudge, marketing window aware.

named_steps.name: SMS: Feedback nudge (inline)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Members not patients. Marketing window 08:00-21:00 contact TZ.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Wait for survey submit
named_steps.comment: Exits on submit. Must not fabricate a score.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: contact.latest_feedback_score (sole writer)
named_steps.comment: Only field this workflow writes. No other contact / opp writes.
